audit_metadata.token_proxy_limitation: Proxy heuristic approximating BPE tokenizers within ~15% margin of error.

channel_2_aria_interactive.pruning_mechanism: None (retained via DEFAULT_INCLUDE_ATTRIBUTES on interactive nodes)
channel_2_aria_interactive.confound_identified: Button aria-label co-locates product title ('SoundFlow Air 3') onto the clickable action target, changing hierarchical reference resolution to direct label matching.

channel_3_aria_non_interactive.pruning_mechanism: serializer.py:L1046-L1058 constructs attributes ONLY if node.is_interactive or scrollable; non-interactive span tags are stripped entirely.

channel_4_data_attrs_default.pruning_mechanism: views.py:DEFAULT_INCLUDE_ATTRIBUTES omits data-*; serializer.py:L1214 discards non-whitelisted attributes.

channel_5_data_attrs_extended.non_interactive_reachability: 0.0% (data-amount on span is still stripped due to L1046)
channel_5_data_attrs_extended.pruning_mechanism: Runner injects EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES to Agent; survives on buttons but dropped on spans.

channel_7_temporal_time.pruning_mechanism: <time> is not interactive; tag stripped; inner text emitted as plain text.
channel_7_temporal_time.confound_identified: Renders as ordinary visible typography; cannot be isolated from plain text.

non_interactive_container_section.finding: Non-interactive <section> tags have both aria-label and data-* stripped, regardless of whitelist.

empty_attribute_values.finding: Empty attributes (aria-label='', data-action='') are pruned by serializer.py:L1214 (str(value).strip() != '').

nested_button_elements.finding: Interactive <button> retains its attributes; child text nodes are concatenated into the button's text representation.
